etymologies.etymologyHTML: L (upper case, lower case l, plural Ls or L's)

quote.citation: 1925 February 21, “Co-operation”, in The New Yorker (cartoon), page 2:
quote.text: PLEASE! HELP US KEEP THE "L" AND SUBWAY CLEAN

definitions.definition: (usually clothing) Initialism of large (the manufactured size or an item of that size).

quote.citation: 1983 April 23, “Classified advertisement”, in Gay Community News, page 14:
quote.text: L wntd to share spacious JP apt w/veget non-smkng indep quiet L, dog, cat.

definitions.definition: (slang) Two cigarette papers laid perpendicularly on each other when making a joint.
(usually clothing) Initialism of large (of the manufactured size).
(linguistics) Initialism of low (variety of a language with limited prestige and official acceptance).
(slang) Bad, subpar, of inferior quality (abbreviation of loser). (Compare noun sense 1 and sense 2.)
